notablePrerequisites: There are four permanents on the battlefield that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{G}{U}.
description:
Cast Doppelgang by paying {15}{G}{U}, creating five token copies of Kairi and of the four mana-producing permanents.
Put all Kairi tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule, triggering each token once.
Resolve the first Kairi trigger, causing you to mill six cards and return Doppelgang from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve all remaining Kairi triggers, choosing either mode as desired.
Activate seventeen of the mana-producing permanent tokens by tapping them, adding at least {15}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
